name: Mombasa and Diani
tagline: Swahili old town and white-sand Indian Ocean beaches
summary: Mombasa is Kenya's ancient Swahili port, with Fort Jesus and a carved-door Old Town, while Diani Beach to the south has some of Africa's finest sand. Explore the fort, eat Swahili biryani, snorkel Kisite marine park with dolphins and end a safari with beach days.
seasonNote: Dry seasons (December to March, July to October) are best; April to June brings long rains.
arrival: Moi International Airport is 20 minutes from the centre; Ukunda airstrip serves Diani; the SGR train from Nairobi takes about 5 hours.
gettingAround: Tuk-tuks and taxis; the Likoni ferry crosses to the south coast.
cashTip: Park fees are paid by card or M-Pesa; carry shillings or small US dollars for tips and village visits.
foodTip: Swahili biryani, mahamri doughnuts and grilled seafood.
